program.name: Death By
program.subject: Conditioning
program.blurb: Climbing ladders that get harder every minute, then a Tabata or an AMRAP to finish.
program.about: Ladders that climb until they are hard: one rep, then two, then three, alternating two moves, until the time is up. A Tabata finishes one day and a short AMRAP the other. It feels easy at first and honest by the end. Abs finish every session. Both later levels add reps.
